architecturalTradeoffSummary: While ML-DSA-65 signatures are ~46x larger than ECDSA (3,309 B vs 71 B), ML-DSA verification executes at sub-millisecond speeds. Q-Trust mitigates on-chain calldata gas costs through a two-layer trust model: smart contracts anchor a 32-byte Poseidon commitment, while client verifiers validate the 3.3 KB ML-DSA signature envelope off-chain.
